name: Snov.io
description: Drive Snov.io lead enrichment and outreach from your AI: find a person's email from name and company domain, verify emails, list the emails of a domain, manage prospect lists and see drip campaigns and the credit balance. Signs in with the API client ID and secret.
instructions:
This connector uses the Snov.io REST API (snov.io/api).

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**:
1. Sign in to https://app.snov.io and open **Account settings → API** (https://app.snov.io/account/api).
2. Copy the **API User ID** into `SNOV_CLIENT_ID` and the **API Secret** into `SNOV_CLIENT_SECRET`.
The connector exchanges them for an access token at `https://api.snov.io/v1/oauth/access_token` (OAuth 2.0 client credentials) and gets a new one every hour by itself. There is nothing to paste or renew by hand.

**Plans**: the API is fully available on the paid (Sales Suite) plans; on the free plan Snov.io gives test access on request (help@snov.io). A 403 "you dont have permissions for this action" on every call means the plan does not include API access; a 401 means the ID or secret is wrong.

**Credits**: `snov_balance`, `snov_get_domain_emails_count`, the prospect lists and the campaigns are free. `snov_email_finder`, `snov_email_verifier`, `snov_email_finder_by_url` and `snov_domain_search` spend credits. Check `snov_balance` before bulk work and do not repeat a search that already returned results.

**Domain search** runs in two steps: `snov_domain_search` starts the search and returns a `task_hash`; `snov_get_domain_search_result` with that hash returns the emails (up to 50 per page). While `status` is `in_progress`, wait a few seconds and ask again. For the next page pass `meta.next` from the result as `next` to `snov_domain_search`. `snov_get_domain_emails_count` tells for free how many emails a domain has before you spend a credit.

**Workflow**: domain emails count → domain search → email finder (name + domain) → email verifier → add the prospect to a list → drip campaign.

**Rate limit**: 60 requests per minute.

**Out of scope here**: editing drip campaign content, the LinkedIn extension, sender accounts, webhooks and deals (Snov.io CRM).

SNOV_CLIENT_ID.label: API User ID
SNOV_CLIENT_ID.help: Snov.io, Account settings, API tab: the API User ID (used as client_id).
SNOV_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the User ID without spaces.

SNOV_CLIENT_SECRET.label: API Secret
SNOV_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same tab: the API Secret (used as client_secret).
SNOV_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the API secret without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Snov.io did not issue a token: check the API User ID and API Secret under Account settings, API.
verifyHints.403: Snov.io refused the call: the plan probably does not include API access (paid plans, or test access on request).
verifyHints.rate_limited: Snov.io allows 60 requests per minute. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: snov_balance
tools.description: Remaining credit balance of the account, with days until the monthly limit resets and until the subscription ends. Free; use it before bulk lookups.

tools.name: snov_get_domain_emails_count
tools.description: How many emails Snov.io knows for a company domain, before spending a credit on snov_domain_search. Free.

tools.name: snov_domain_search
tools.description: Start a search for the emails of a company domain. Returns a task_hash; read the emails with snov_get_domain_search_result. Costs 1 credit per unique request, so check snov_get_domain_emails_count first.

domain.description: Company domain, e.g. snov.io, without https:// or a path.

next.description: For the next page: meta.next from the previous snov_get_domain_search_result.

tools.name: snov_get_domain_search_result
tools.description: Read the emails found by snov_domain_search: up to 50 emails per page, total_count, meta.next for the next page and status (completed or in_progress; when in progress wait a few seconds and ask again). The emails are not verified. Free.

tools.name: snov_email_finder
tools.description: Find a person's email from first name, last name and company domain. Spends credits; the answer lists the emails found with their status.

tools.name: snov_email_verifier
tools.description: Check whether one email address can receive mail: valid, invalid, catch-all, disposable or webmail, with the SMTP and MX checks. Spends a credit.

tools.name: snov_email_finder_by_url
tools.description: Find the emails of a person from a LinkedIn profile URL. Spends credits.

tools.name: snov_list_prospect_lists
tools.description: List the prospect lists of the account (id, name, number of contacts). Use the id with snov_add_prospect_to_list. Free.

tools.name: snov_create_prospect_list
tools.description: Create a new, empty prospect list and return its id for snov_add_prospect_to_list. Free.

tools.name: snov_add_prospect_to_list
tools.description: Add a prospect (person) to a list. Required: email + listId.

tools.name: snov_list_drip_campaigns
tools.description: List the drip (email outreach) campaigns: id, name, the prospect list used, status (Active, Paused, Draft) and dates. Free.
